text:
Anya: heads-up — I want to run a light CRM janitor this week to mark clearly stale onboarding contacts and kick a low-touch reactivation playbook for paying accounts. Criteria: last_activity < 45d AND mrr_cents > 50000. Exclude enterprise pilots and accounts with recent owner claims. thoughts?

matt_b: sounds reasonable. can we exclude enterprise pilots and any manually flagged accounts? also want a rollback sql ready.

Sanjay: agree + one ask — if we flip onboard_status to 'stale' we should adjust health_score so downstream dashboards don't treat them as healthy. maybe subtract 0.2 but cap at 0.0.

Anya: yup planned. dry-run first. proposed action (pseudo-sql):
```sql
UPDATE contacts
SET onboard_status = 'stale',
    health_score = GREATEST(0, health_score - 0.2),
    tags = array_append(tags, 'janitor-gentle-2024-02')
WHERE last_touch < now() - interval '45 days'
  AND mrr_cents > 50000
  AND NOT (tags @> ARRAY['enterprise_pilot'])
  AND owner_claimed_at IS NULL;
```

linda_ops: can we run a staging dry-run sample (1k rows) and surface the delta report? I can own approving prod after review.

CS-Bot: Job 'janitor-gentle-2024-02' queued for dry-run: 2024-02-12T03:00:00Z. Results will post to #customer-success once done.

matt_b: quick rollback snippet I sketched:
```sql
-- rollback: revert onboard_status where tag matches and run_after is within window
UPDATE contacts
SET onboard_status = previous_onboard_status, health_score = previous_health_score
WHERE tags @> ARRAY['janitor-gentle-2024-02'];
```
we need to persist previous_* fields in the dry-run to validate.

Anya: good call — we'll snapshot previous_onboard_status & previous_health_score into a temp table during dry-run. also will add telemetry tag `janitor_run=gentle-2024-02` for tracing in logs.

Sanjay: also add a short delay before firing reactivation playbook: require owner to claim within 24h, otherwise put into low-priority nurture sequence. reduces churny outreach.

linda_ops: plan LGTM. once dry-run report + sample CSV looks sane I'll give prod go-ahead. thanks y'all. :white_check_mark:
